value.rationale: The new exact Floquet discriminant identifies a sharp internal spectral transition at \(\beta=\sqrt2\) within the positive periodic solution interval \(1<\beta<(3+\sqrt{17})/2\). Distinct unit-modulus, defective minus-one, and negative hyperbolic spectra quantify perturbation dynamics even though all three phases have the same unique positive forcing-period state. The explicit defective Jordan proof is nontrivial and independent of the known existence/uniqueness result; not a mere renaming, parameter substitution or insignificant numerical refinement.
